missing_evidence: TRIAGE-DEDUP-01 full grouping key for each raw event
TRIAGE-DEDUP-02 cardinality analysis across users, hosts, source IPs, tenants, and time buckets
TRIAGE-DEDUP-03 fresh prior disposition tied to current rule and asset context
TRIAGE-DEDUP-04 retained outlier list and grouping rationale
TRIAGE-SUP-01 scoped owner, expiry, rollback, and ticket

should_flag.finding: Alert storm spans many users, hosts, source IPs, and tenants, so it cannot be collapsed as duplicate notifications without spread analysis.

Kill-chain coverage was not checked before hiding recurring authentication anomaly activity.
